mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, which typically boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST > 1.25 million units), rising home construction activity boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1250, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) level indicates robust manufacturing activity, which typically supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts quickly to supply-side strength.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is rising (month-over-month increase > 0.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 19,000 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 19000) signals strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 19000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer and housing demand, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through enhanced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are rising (month-over-month increase > 0.5%), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) reflects a tight labor market, which typically supports sustained economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in long-term economic strength.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
